operator_values_without_register_row._note: Answered keys (PLAN section 2.3) with no question-register row. S3 answers breakGlassUPN and breakGlassUserId (PLAN section 2.3: 'S3 answered'): discovery derives the break-glass account from CA exclusions x Global Administrators, and S3's emergency account sits in no CA exclusion, so discovery finds none and Muster takes these as the answered fallback (operatorValues.ts OPV_FALLBACK_VARS). breakGlassUserId is the simulator object id of emergency.access (user-60). adminUserName is a name stem (Stamper builds admin-<stem>@<tenant>); touFileBase64 is a minimal valid PDF; subscriptionId is the empty Azure Government subscription (no resources; the overrides gate needs all twelve keys). The other operator values come from register answers: wifiSsid TCP.MU.006, securityEmail / cisoEmail TCP.MU.007, approverUPN TCP.MU.001, cuiGroupName TCP.GA.002 (CUI-Authorized-Users).
